www.MarChiropractic.com
MAR - Mar Animal Rehab🐾👩🏻‍⚕️

Animal Chiro/Rehab therapy focuses on the health & recovery of the neuro-musculoskeletal system, offering a hands-on, non-surgical treatment option. Animal Chiro/Rehab does not replace veterinary medicine nor assume responsibility of primary health care. Chiro/Rehab for animals is meant to enhance comprehensive healthcare through integrative approach

Benefits of Chiro/Rehab for Animals:
•Decreases Pain by Reducing Joint Misalignment
•Slows Progression of Degenerative Conditions
•Stimulates Circulation, Increases Lymph Drainage & Flexibility 
•Increases Nervous System Function
•Wonderful Pain Management for Cats
•Can Help Animals Wean Off Certain Medications (Under DVM Supervision)
•Allows for Symmetrical, Balanced Growth & Development
•Increases Quality (& often Quantity) of Life During Final Days
